chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Playing silent films at the Eblon theater
summary: Kuehl reads that he played for silent films at the Eblon theater; Basie says all but the passion plays are his words.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah. Okay. "And surprisingly, fast found that spot, playing the accompaniment to silent films at a local movie theater." Okay, so we're back to that. Okay, let's see. All righty. A movie theater called the Eblon (PHONETIC). E-b-l-o-n. "I must say, I got a lot of good experience in that job because I was playing for all sorts of pictures -- anything from a Western melodrama to a crime thriller or one of those passion plays." Are those your words?
All but "the passion plays" are mine.
Well. All right. Should I continue? Or was there anything that you wanted to say?
